[![Howard Rees Header](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/e/ef/Howard_Rees_Header.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20080324022648)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/e/ef/Howard_Rees_Header.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20080324022648)

**Howard K. Rees** is a former Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 1969 to 1975. Prior to his work at Mattel, he accepted a position at Ford of Europe. Rees left the Hot Wheels design team in 1971 to design the Major Matt Mason action figures, recommending a friend of his named [Larry Wood](/wiki/Larry_Wood) to the position. Rees left Mattel entirely in 1975 and became a painter, which he still is to this day.
